correctness.rationale: For A2, multiplication is xy=x1 y1 e3. Testing the nine ordered basis pairs forces the first coordinates of R(e2) and R(e3) to vanish. The (e1,e1) equation then gives exactly 2 a d=0 and a(a-2g)=0, with no further restrictions. This immediately forces r23=0 on the nonzero-r11 complex branch and supplies a concrete failing matrix from the printed family. The packaged checker reconstructs the defects symbolically and exhaustively confirms the finite-field counts over F2 and F3.
